components.name: Section Nav Link

components.html: 事件攻略人物秘笈
components.css: .ds-topnav { display: flex; gap: 0.25rem 1.25rem; font: 400 16px/1.8 'Noto Serif TC', serif; } .ds-topnav a { color: var(--m-fg, #2b333e); text-decoration: none; padding: 0.25rem 0; } .ds-topnav a:hover { color: var(--m-accent, #861717); } .ds-topnav a[aria-current='page'] { font-weight: 600; } .ds-underline { display: inline-block; padding: 0 0.1rem 0.35rem; border-bottom: 3px solid var(--m-seal, #c1272d); }

components.name: Sidebar Link
components.description: Sidebar entry. Wash on hover, seal fill for the current page, muted when the entry is unwritten.
components.html:
1. 普通條目
  2. 目前頁面
  3. 尚未撰寫
components.css: .ds-side { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; font: 400 16px/1.6 'Noto Serif TC', serif; } .ds-side a { display: block; padding: 0.3rem 0.6rem; color: var(--m-fg, #2b333e); text-decoration: none; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-side a:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--m-fg, #2b333e) 7%, rgb(var(--m-paper-rgb, 252 250 240))); } .ds-side a[aria-current='page'] { background: var(--m-seal, #c1272d); color: #fff; } .ds-side a.ds-missing { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--m-fg, #2b333e) 74%, rgb(var(--m-paper-rgb, 252 250 240))); } .ds-side a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--m-seal, #c1272d); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Wiki Table
components.description: Plain ruled lookup table; header on a paper wash with a 2px ink bottom rule.
components.css: .ds-table { border-collapse: collapse; font: 400 0.9375rem/1.8 'Noto Serif TC', serif; min-width: 100%; color: var(--m-fg, #2b333e); } .ds-table th, .ds-table td { border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--m-fg, #2b333e) 22%, rgb(var(--m-paper-rgb, 252 250 240))); padding: 0.35rem 0.6rem; text-align: left; vertical-align: top; } .ds-table th { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--m-fg, #2b333e) 7%, rgb(var(--m-paper-rgb, 252 250 240))); font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--m-fg, #2b333e); }

components.name: Entry List Item

components.css: .ds-entries { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: 'Noto Serif TC', serif; } .ds-entries li { display: grid; gap: 0.1rem; padding: 0.5rem 0; border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--m-fg, #2b333e) 22%, rgb(var(--m-paper-rgb, 252 250 240))); } .ds-entries a { font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; color: var(--m-accent, #861717); } .ds-entries a:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-underline-offset: 0.2em; } .ds-entries span { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--m-fg, #2b333e) 74%, rgb(var(--m-paper-rgb, 252 250 240))); font-size: 0.9375rem; }

narrative.overview: A reference opened on a second monitor mid-run, laid out like a desk with a scroll on it. Texture and brushwork live in the margins, edges and seals; the reading text stays on calm paper. The visual vocabulary is the pinned library @shuimo-design/react (beta): a raw rice-paper ground, brush-drawn rules, one cinnabar seal. The project stylesheet only lays out and re-expresses the library's --m-* tokens; it adds no palette of its own. Ink effects are reserved for borders, titles, dividers and stamps; tables and lists are never inked. Two themes share one structure: 宣紙 (light) and 墨夜 (dark).
keyCharacteristics: Rice-paper ground over the whole viewport, with the main column as the only scroller.
Brush rules (MBorder, MDivider) separate regions instead of boxes and cards.
One red voice: the seal. Everything else is ink on paper.
Noto Serif TC for everything, with weight 900 reserved for the title and brand.
One authored motion: the page settles in and the title rule is drawn left to right.

rules.name: The One Seal Rule
rules.body: The seal red is the only chromatic color. It marks place (current page, brand stamp) and focus, never decoration or status.

rules.name: The Derived Neutrals Rule
rules.body: Muted, wash and line are always mixed from --m-fg and the paper token, never hard-coded, so both themes follow without a second palette.

rules.name: The Tabular Count Rule
rules.body: Numbers that index (list numbers, months) use tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Brush Is The Border Rule
rules.body: Regions are divided by MBorder and MDivider strokes (thickness 3), each with its own seed so repeated strokes differ. Do not box regions with CSS borders; the table's hairline grid is the only ruled structure.

dos: Do express new colors as mixes of --m-fg and the paper token, or as library --m-* tokens, so light and dark both follow.
Do keep seal red for place and focus: current marks, the brand stamp, selection and the focus ring.
Do separate regions with MBorder and MDivider strokes, and give each a distinct seed.
Do keep reading text on plain paper in Noto Serif TC at 1.8 line height inside the 56rem column.
Do keep tables plain: hairline grid, wash header, no ink effects.
Do gate every animation behind prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.
donts: Don't put ink or brush effects on dense tables or lists.
Don't build a SaaS sidebar-and-cards dashboard: no card grids, no shadows, no pills.
Don't add a second accent hue or use red decoratively.
Don't hard-code light-only hex values in project CSS; they break 墨夜.
Don't show far-mountain imagery outside the home page.
